claim: If game speed follows update duration or CPU time, any speed-up (or added hook time) changes the game's pace, so hold each update to its original length by crediting saved time back.

evidence.text: Sprite fast path: without its saving added back to the pace (spr_credit) the simulator's pace ran 14% fast (7.41 frames an update against 8.59); with it 8.47 (fast) against 8.59 (plain).
evidence.quote: without it the simulator's pace ran 14% fast (7.41 frames an update against 8.59).
